Can your website work without a mouse?

Can your website work without a mouse?

Updated 3 October 2026. September and the 2 October post remain historical entries. Revised plan: 26 themes from 6 October–31 December, adapted into 156 platform drafts. Nothing has been published or scheduled by this workbook.
Internal planning revision, 2026-10-03
Completion controls
Use existing ☐ / ✓ / N/A dropdowns. Keep copy approval, asset readiness, link testing and Published separate. Fill actual dates, URLs and real metrics after execution—not before.
Workflow
Draft → In production → Ready → Scheduled → Published. A planned date is not proof of publication. Preserve existing owners and completed task records.
Cadence

Two themes each week, plus 3 December inclusion education. Not every asset must be posted everywhere: prioritise relevant audiences. GBP: one core update weekly; additional educational posts optional. Pinterest: evergreen checklists; greetings optional.
Expired offer
Digital Launchpad ended 25 September 2026. Keep historical rows for records; do not reuse old offer captions, prices or urgency. No reactivation is planned.
DigiBizID venture

DigiBizID is an eLan Technology venture, not one of the four portal products. Use Nishant’s live card as the demo. Verify final domain, subscription availability, price and terms before any sales launch. Approved future card prices must state GST extra.
https://elan-tech.net/ventures/digibizid/
Release gates
Each draft includes a Before publishing check. If a destination or feature is not ready, use the fallback caption/contact link and remove the unverified claim. Do not manufacture a launch date.
Project permissions

Healthy Genie name, logo, development screenshots and both public links are approved. Label preview/WIP; test features before showing them. Other client assets need separate permission; names and verified technology references are not proof of measurable results. Beautiphi is not highlighted in latest-work posts.
https://www.healthygenie.in/ | https://healthygenie.elantech.cloud/
Posting times

Existing IST time slots are starting hypotheses, not guaranteed best times. Compare native reach, saves, clicks and actual enquiries over comparable periods, then adjust. No paid-media budget assumed.
Creative system

Use generous white space, eLan teal/orange/blue, a single strong headline and readable hierarchy. Produce original diagrams, demos and checklists. Do not present generated mockups as real client work. Each theme includes slides, art direction, shot sequence and voiceover.
Canvas sizes
FB/IG carousel 1080×1350; Reels/Status 1080×1920; LinkedIn carousel 1080×1350; GBP 1200×900; Pinterest 1000×1500. Keep text away from crop edges and player overlays.
Accessibility education

Explain keyboard focus, labels, alt text, captions, contrast, zoom, error states and audit → remediation → retest. Quick checks are not a full assessment. Use accessibility-first development wording; no universal WCAG/ADA guarantee. Make campaign assets accessible too.
https://www.w3.org/WAI/test-evaluate/easy-checks/
Google Business Profile

Use relevant Update posts and a tested Learn more destination. Keep descriptions factual and avoid phone numbers inside post copy, guarantees, unapproved project assets and unsupported health claims. Maintain correct hours; ask genuine clients for voluntary reviews without incentives.
https://elan-tech.net/contact/
WhatsApp outreach

Use Status freely within your audience settings. Direct messages only to recipients with appropriate permission/relevance; group messages only with admin permission and group rules. Do not scrape numbers or bulk send. Honour opt-outs and never request sensitive details in a group.
Performance

Log actual reach, clicks and qualified enquiries. A phone/WhatsApp click is not a confirmed lead. Verify form-to-inbox delivery. Review consent-based analytics, native channel metrics and relevant Search Console landing pages together; do not invent results.
UTM links

Future draft destinations have campaign tags. Use matching landing pages. Keep Instagram profile links aligned with the post; WhatsApp Status links tested on mobile. Never put names, emails, phone numbers or other personal identifiers into UTMs.
Privacy education

Teach purpose clarity, minimisation, appropriate permission, access, retention, vendor mapping and consent verification. Technical implementation is not legal certification. Check current DPDP commencement/applicability and international requirements with appropriate legal advice. Optional site analytics stays consent-based.
https://www.meity.gov.in/documents/act-and-policies/digital-personal-dataprotection-rules-2025gDOxUjMtQWa?pageTitle=Digital-Personal-Data-ProtectionRules-2025
Coverage

All 13 services: design, development, commerce, SEO, marketing, mobile apps, branding, maintenance/security, integrations, accessibility, CRM/ERP (ERPNext), DPDP implementation and headless CMS (Payload/Directus). Four portals: real estate, medical conference, IMA society and resort management.
https://elan-tech.net/services/ | https://elan-tech.net/products/
Monthly review

Review 30 October, 30 November and 31 December. Compare equal 28-day periods; identify useful enquiries and engaging topics. Refresh captions using actual questions, not a changing homepage H1. Consolidate useful content before adding duplicate articles.
Scope and costs

Source code, ownership, licensing, payment schedule, hosting, maintenance, APIs and upgrades depend on written proposal and terms. No fabricated testimonials, awards, savings, rankings, compliance badges or performance scores.
https://elan-tech.net/terms-of-service/
Progress sheet

Existing formulas and checkbox trackers are retained. Progress includes all 35 historical+future themes; do not count an unpublished historical row as a completed post. Actual metrics remain blank until recorded.
English and tone

Plain English, specific examples and one useful next step. Teach before selling. Avoid fear-based privacy/security copy, accessibility stereotypes and excessive hashtags. No BNI mention in new profile graphics.
